answer: To counter Sybil attacks, networks enforce cryptographic attestation chains verifying verifiable compute via zero-knowledge proofs. Every validation pulse requires staking deposits that increase exponentially with cluster size. Like a jetty breaking ocean surges, this mechanism imposes superlinear capital exhaustion on each rogue swarm. Even if an attacker deploys a raven identity framework, the compounding staking cost rapidly renders automated clone armies economically unviable.
